description: Minister of Lab our Foreign Employment - Cancel the Extra Gazette No.2382/04 of April 30th 2024 The Tea Growing and Manufacturing Trade. Cancel the Extra Gazette No.2382/04 of April 30th 2024 The Rubber Cultivation and raw Rubber Processing Trade.
reasoning: This gazette content involves the cancellation of notifications under the Wages Boards Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It deals with legal powers conferred by ordinance, cancellation of previous gazette notifications, and the determination of minimum daily payments for workers - all falling under legal/regulatory framework modifications rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
